<function name="CapabilitiesClear" parent="NPC" type="classfunc">
	<description>Removes all of Capabilities the NPC has.</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Removes all of the Capabilities that the NPC has.</description>
	<code>self:CapabilitiesClear()</code>

</example>
